components.name: Success Button
components.description: Positive operational action button for delivery confirmation, opening tables, and payment registration.
components.css: .ds-btn-success { background: #16a34a; color: #fff; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.625rem 1.25rem; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; font: 500 0.875rem/1.3 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-success:hover { background: #15803d; } .ds-btn-success:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00d4a4; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-success:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Operational Card
components.description: Flat bordered card for orders, tables, and operational groups.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; color: #0a0a0a; border: 1px solid #e5e5e5; border-radius: .75rem; padding: 1rem; box-shadow: none; } .ds-card h2 { margin: 0; font: 700 1.125rem/1.35 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin: .25rem 0 0; color: #5a5a5c; font: 400 .875rem/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Default form field for operational forms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: .25rem; font: 500 .875rem/1.3 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #0a0a0a; } .ds-input { height: 2.5rem; border: 1px solid #e5e5e5; border-radius: .6rem; padding: .5rem 1rem; background: #fff; color: #0a0a0a; font: 400 1rem/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00d4a4; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input:disabled { background: #f7f7f7; opacity: .5; }

narrative.overview: Restaurante Comandas is a product UI for real restaurant work. The design should feel like a clean service rail: every item has a place, every action is reachable, and nothing decorative competes with the next operational decision.
keyCharacteristics: Mobile-first operational density without visual clutter.
Cards used as command units, not decoration.
Live-update surfaces that preserve local user state.
Profile-contained area switching for users with multiple permissions.

rules.name: The Operational Color Rule
rules.body: Green means a positive operational action; red means destructive, cancel, or danger; neutral means navigation or inspection.

rules.name: The No-Fog Rule
rules.body: Muted text must stay readable. If a label matters to the task, it cannot be pale gray for elegance.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Operational cards are bordered and flat at rest. Do not add decorative drop shadows to cards or buttons.

dos: Do preserve existing routes, components, business rules, authentication, analytics/dataLayer, and tenant-aware access checks.
Do use green only for positive operational actions and red only for destructive/cancel actions.
Do keep touch targets comfortable on mobile and make focus states visible.
donts: Don't rewrite the app or rebuild flows from scratch for visual polish.
Don't use standalone area-switch links in protected operational layouts; use the profile menu.
Don't change backend, database, authentication, analytics, GTM, GA4, dataLayer, or business logic without explicit approval.
